rules: The testing manager is the OMP project supervisor; it alone integrates, commits and reports the release state.
Managed workers start only through agent-team-orca-start with a stable assignment ID; at most two attempts per ID.
No role declares production readiness. The only decision source is production-readiness.json from ./test production-check|release-check on clean, recorded commits.
Worker claims are unverified until the manager re-runs the named ./test stage and inspects the evidence directory.
Live providers, payments, WhatsApp, production data and policy promotion stay out of every assignment.

testing-manager.runs_as: OMP project supervisor (Claude Opus 5.5 for this project); not a managed worker
testing-manager.acceptance: Every gate row traceable to a command, log and commit; checkpoint written at each hard gate.

backend-test.acceptance: Named stages PASS on a clean Karmi commit; failures diagnosed to root cause, never skipped or weakened.

parakh-evaluation.acceptance: 60-case demo matches the reviewed baseline; any baseline change comes with a reviewed diff (--accept-baseline) and a reason.

integration.acceptance: Karmi telemetry -> Parakh import -> signed candidate -> Karmi SHADOW with unchanged live route; negative cases (signature, version, duplicate) rejected; PARAKH_REQUIRE_KARMI=1.

mobile-test.acceptance: 13 steps PASS with candidate_build_install, source_provenance and installed_candidate PASS on the attached phone. Uninstalling apps or changing device settings requires the phone owner's approval.

security.acceptance: Secret, config, negative auth and OSV checks PASS; new fake fixtures pinned by exact fingerprint only after review; no secret values in evidence.

performance.acceptance: Regression rule holds against the measured baseline on the same host class; thresholds cite their measurement source; production SLOs remain the owner gate SLO_APPROVAL.

release-gate.acceptance: Read-only: reports state and not_passing rows from production-readiness.json for the recorded SHAs; confirms both trees were clean; never edits evidence, code or gates.
